title: Attention Ore
description: Redstone ore behaves like Target Blocks
body:
This mod uses a modified version of Fabric (Babric) and is designed only for Better than Adventure, a heavily modified version of Minecraft b1.7.3! For more information, join the discord server provided on this projects page.

#About
Makes redstone ore redirect redstone dust, behaving like a target block from modern.
Only needs to be on the server, but will have some visual discrepancies if the client doesn't have it
